_note: Brigade Road, Bangalore. Four real camera feeds live directly in data/ (no clips/ subfolder). Files are looked up by exact name. Run 'python pipeline/calibrate.py --extract --overlay' inside Docker to verify entry_line and zone polygons against real frames. All four feeds are 1920x1080.

cameras._note: Entrance door feed. Entry line is a horizontal segment at ~78% of frame height — people cross it when entering/exiting. Only this camera emits ENTRY/EXIT.
Zone feed covering the top-shelf brand bays (EB Korean -> Accessories row). ASSUMPTION: CAM 1 = top-shelf bays; correct here after watching the clip if CAM 1/CAM 2 are swapped.
Zone feed covering the bottom-shelf brand bays (Maybelline -> Streax row). ASSUMPTION: CAM 2 = bottom-shelf bays; swap with CAM_ZONE_1 if footage differs.
Cash Counter / billing area. The CASH_COUNTER zone drives billing-queue join/abandon events.
